sections.heading: Mission
paragraphs: Turn one human mission into assigned work and shared deliverables inside Ambiguous.ai.

sections.heading: Human and agent collaboration
paragraphs: The human defines success and reviews the result. Agents break down the work, draft requirements, and prepare presentation material.

sections.heading: Acceptance criteria
paragraphs: Every task has a named human or agent owner and clear completion criteria.
Requirements, presentation slides, and discussion stay in the same Ambiguous workspace.
Human approval is visible before the mission is considered complete.

sections.heading: Demo scope
paragraphs: This dedicated demo contains a real native document, editable slides, and a private channel shared only with the human owner, Codex, and Hermes.
Agent contributions are authored by Codex and posted through the human-authorized integration. Native chat authors are not impersonated.
